title: Local ceasefire in Ukraine's Kherson region for an aid mission to occupied Oleshky
dek: A ceasefire around the Russian-occupied town of Oleshky took effect on 27 October so aid can go in and civilians can leave. US First Lady Melania Trump helped broker it.
happened: The ceasefire took effect in the early hours of 27 October in Oleshky and nearby areas of Kherson region. It was announced on 23 October; Al Jazeera and AP report that Melania Trump brokered it, with Pope Leo XIV also involved. Oleshky, on the eastern bank of the Dnipro opposite Ukrainian-held Kherson city, has been occupied by Russia since early 2022 and is cut off by mined roads and drone attacks.

sides.says: Ombudsman Dmytro Lubinets said on 27 October that both sides were fully honouring the ceasefire; his office said demining had begun and evacuations would start on 30 October. The head of the presidential office called it a "bilateral ceasefire".

The Defence Ministry said its forces had stopped fighting in the area to prepare for the mission, and Kremlin spokesman Dmitry Peskov reported no violations. The Russian-installed regional head said evacuees could stay in Russia or travel to Ukrainian-held territory.
UN humanitarian coordinator Matthias Schmale said civilians in the town were trapped "without a guaranteed safe exit route".

next: Doctors, medicine, food and water are to go in before evacuation corridors open. The pause is due to last through 31 October or longer according to AP, and until 1 November according to Ukraine's ombudsman. Within minutes of it starting, Russia fired ballistic missiles at other parts of Ukraine, including Kyiv.
summary: Oleshky had about 24,000 people before the full-scale invasion. The UN says up to 2,000 remain; in September Ukraine's ombudsman put the number at more than 6,000. Residents face shortages of food, water, medicine and electricity, and leaving has been made dangerous by mines and drones. The pause covers only the Oleshky area and comes as Washington tries to revive talks between Moscow and Kyiv.

sources.title: Russia halts strikes on Ukraine's Kherson as Oleshky ceasefire takes effect
Local ceasefire in besieged Oleshky begins, Ukrainian, Russian officials say
